snippet.title: Ultrapolis Cyberpunk City Builder Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/5314650

Ultrapolis is a cyberpunk city diorama game inspired by 90s anime like Ghost in the Shell and Akira.

Trailer music by SWCR https://www.youtube.com/@UCj3460Ylt4JEcEiW6PxCH9Q
